description:
## Problem
26 linked worktrees from earlier corpus rule rounds remain beside the primary clone: the corpus-rule-r2 member worktree, the corpus-rule-r3 integration worktree and its seven member worktrees, BenchBox.wt-crr-fix-*, wt-crr-gate-*, wt-crr-legacy-*, wt-crr-review-*, wt-crr-mirror-workflow, wt-crr-rankings-fix, wt-crr-batch1-review, wt-staging-crr-a5, wt-staging-crr-v4-review, and /private/tmp/benchbox-crr-readers-test. They use disk and make worktree listings and batch status harder to read. This item uses make worktree-remove per worktree; the batch-level tool is aborted-batch-worktrees-have-no-cleanup-path-20261107 and is not required.

## Change
- For each, confirm it is clean and that every commit is contained in develop, feat/corpus-rule-r4, a kept staging branch (feat/staging-crr-*), origin/published-results, or its own origin branch at the same tip, by ancestry or by patch equivalence (`git cherry <ref> <branch>` shows no `+` lines). Record the ref and the method per worktree. Then remove it with make worktree-remove and delete its local branch with `git branch -d` (or `-D` only when containment was shown by patch equivalence, recorded with the expected tip).
- The current batch's member worktrees are removed by make batch-finish, not by this item.

## Decision gates
- make worktree-remove refuses detached worktrees and worktrees whose directory is missing (wt-crr-batch1-review; /private/tmp/benchbox-crr-readers-test, directory gone, listed prunable). List them with their commit and ask the owner before using any other command for them.
- A worktree with uncommitted changes, or with commits not contained in any kept ref: list it and ask the owner; do not remove it.
- Never run git worktree prune or git gc; never delete a remote branch without owner approval.

## Verification rubric
- The context records each worktree with its decision (removed or kept) and the ref that contains its commits.

## Guardrails
- No pull request and no file edits. Never run git worktree prune, git gc, or remote branch deletion without owner approval. Never remove a worktree with uncommitted or untracked changes. Record the command and output for every removal in the item context. When a decision gate's stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner with the evidence.
